earn-points.title: Earn reward points
earn-points.seoTitle: Earn Reward Points on Every Order | Sasta Milaga
earn-points.description: Earn 1 point for every Rs 100 on completed orders, move up from Bronze to Platinum for up to double points, and use points at checkout.
earn-points.body:
Every completed Sasta Milaga Local order earns points. Use them to pay part of your next order.

How you earn

  • You earn 1 point for every Rs 100 of items on an order.
  • Points are added when the order is completed (delivered and paid). An order that is only placed, or later cancelled, earns nothing.
  • Delivery charges do not earn points. Points or wallet money you used on an order are not rewarded again.
  • If a completed order is refunded or cancelled afterwards, the points it earned are taken back.

Levels give you more points

Your level depends on what you have spent on completed orders in total. A higher level multiplies the points you earn.

LevelTotal spent on completed ordersPoints multiplier
BronzeFrom Rs 0×1
SilverRs 10,000×1.25
GoldRs 30,000×1.5
PlatinumRs 75,000×2

Example: a completed Gold order with Rs 4,000 of items earns 40 × 1.5 = 60 points.

How you use points

  • 1 point is worth Rs 1 at checkout.
  • You need at least 100 points before you can use them.
  • Points and wallet money can pay up to 30% of the items subtotal on one order.

Where to see your points

Your balance, level and history are in your Sasta Milaga account, the same account you use to order. Open your account. You can also try the daily spin for extra points.

Questions

Do I earn on cash on delivery orders?

Yes, when the order is completed. The points are added after delivery and payment, not when you place the order.

Do points expire?

We do not list an expiry date in the rewards rules. Use them whenever you like once you have 100.

Why did my points go down?

Points are taken back when an order they came from is refunded or cancelled after completion. Your account history shows each change and its reason.

daily-spin.title: Daily spin
daily-spin.seoTitle: Daily Spin: Win Points and Wallet Money | Sasta Milaga
daily-spin.description: Spin once a day for 10 to 100 points or Rs 50 wallet money. Prizes, chances and who can spin.
daily-spin.body:
Spin once a day for points or wallet money.

How it works

  • Members can spin once per day.
  • You need at least 1 completed order before you can spin. This keeps fake sign-ups from collecting prizes.
  • Spin from your account. Open your account.

Prizes and chances

PrizeChance per spin
10 points40%
25 points25%
Try again (no prize)20%
50 points10%
Rs 50 wallet money4%
100 points1%

These are the current chances. Points can be used at checkout under the points rules.

Questions

Can I spin more than once a day?

No. One spin per member per day.

Why can I not spin?

You need at least one completed order, and you can only spin once each day.

seller-rules.title: Seller rules and policies
seller-rules.seoTitle: Seller Rules & Policies for Sasta Milaga Sellers
seller-rules.description: Rules for selling on Sasta Milaga: genuine products only, real photos, honest prices, dispatch, returns, 15% commission and payouts.
seller-rules.body:
Sellers on Sasta Milaga sell genuine products with real photos and honest prices, dispatch on time and follow our returns policy.

We collect payment from the customer (cash on delivery) and pay you your share after delivery.

Products

  • Genuine products only. No counterfeit, replica or “first copy” branded goods, and no prohibited or unsafe items.
  • Use your own photos of the actual product. No borrowed brand photos or misleading images.
  • Product names say what the item is, with size, colour or model if relevant. No keyword stuffing.
  • Prices in rupees, with a sale price only if it is really lower than the normal price.
  • Every listing is reviewed by our team before it goes live and can be removed if it breaks these rules.

Orders and dispatch

  • Keep stock quantities correct so customers do not order items you cannot send.
  • Pack securely and hand over the parcel when we confirm the order.
  • Our team shares delivery details for each order, to protect customer privacy.

Returns

Customers can return within 7 days of delivery (see the returns policy). Damaged or wrong items are the seller’s responsibility. The item value is deducted from the seller’s earnings for that order.

Commission and payouts

  • 15% commission on delivered items only. No listing fee.
  • Earnings become available 7 days after delivery, which is the return window.
  • Payouts start from Rs 1,000, to JazzCash, EasyPaisa or a bank account in your name.

Your account

  • One seller account per business. The information in your application must be true.
  • Repeated late dispatch, wrong items or fake listings can suspend selling and hold payouts while we investigate.

Apply to sell on WhatsApp

Questions

Is there a fee to join?

No. There is no joining or listing fee. Commission is charged only on delivered items.

When do I get paid?

Your share of a delivered order becomes available after the 7-day return window. Request a payout once you reach Rs 1,000.

Can I sell branded products?

Only genuine products you are allowed to sell. Replica or counterfeit items are removed and can close the seller account.
